title: eDNA Extraction from Buffer EtOH 100% Using DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit
author: delphine.vanhaecke Vanhaecke
materials: In the flowhood, add 200 µl EtOH 100%.

steps.title: Clean hood and pipettes
steps.instruction: Wipe the laminar flow hood and all micropipettes with DNAZAP solution 1 and 2, then rinse thoroughly with double‑distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare PPE, tubes, UV decontaminate
steps.instruction: Put on disposable gloves and sleeves, place one‑and‑a‑half ml sterilized LoBind tubes (one per sample plus one negative control) inside the hood and expose them to UV light for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Sterilize filter tubes with bleach and ethanol
steps.instruction: Treat the tubes that contain the filters with 10 % bleach, let them air‑dry, then wipe them with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Bead‑beat filter twice with rest
steps.instruction: Place each tube with its filter (stored in 99.9 % EtOH) in a bead‑beater and run for 20 seconds at 4.0 m/s, rest the tubes for 5 minutes, then bead‑beat a second time under the same conditions.

steps.title: Transfer EtOH to LoBind tube
steps.instruction: In the flow hood, remove the EtOH buffer from each tube and pipet it into a fresh 1.5 ml sterilized LoBind tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the LoBind tubes containing EtOH for 60 minutes at 8000 rpm and 6 °C; verify that a pellet has formed at the bottom.

steps.title: Refill tubes with EtOH and store frozen
steps.instruction: Add fresh EtOH to the tubes so the filter is submerged, then store the tubes at –80 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Back in the flow hood, carefully discard the supernatant and let the pellet air‑dry with a fan for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents and prepare PBS
steps.instruction: To each pellet add 20 µl proteinase K, 200 µl 1× PBS, and 200 µl Buffer AL. Prepare 5 ml of 1× PBS fresh by mixing 500 µl PBS 10× with 4 500 µl nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes thoroughly, then incubate at 56 °C for 2 hours in a thermoshaker set to 600 rpm. After incubation vortex for 15 seconds and mix by vortexing again.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Pipet 650 µl of the lysate into a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube, centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 minute, then discard the flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube, add 600 µl Buffer AW1, centrifuge for 1 minute at 8000 rpm, and discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 and dry
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to another fresh 2 ml collection tube, add 600 µl Buffer AW2, centrifuge for 3 minutes at 14 000 rpm to dry the membrane, then discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA – first elution
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean 1.5 ml LoBind tube, pipet 75 µl Buffer AE onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 minute to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Elute DNA – second elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous elution step in a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube to obtain a second eluate.

steps.title: Discard column and store DNA
steps.instruction: Dispose of the used spin column and store the combined eDNA eluates at –20 °C.
